$comment: AUTHORED BASELINE — the number-to-title binding for docs/34-gate-independence.md's sub-shapes. Not a regen artifact, for the reason in lint-shape-index.ts's header: regenerated from the document, it would rewrite itself to agree with a renumber and report that as a pass. Append with `npx tsx packages/engine/lint-shape-index.ts --accept`, which appends only and refuses to rewrite an existing binding. Changing a binding is a HAND edit, and the PR that makes it owes the ~58 citations an update.
